hypothesis: With newly disjoint training/calibration/evaluation seeds and a mechanistically targeted post-switch-history ablation, the learned continuous-feature memory retains a pre-frozen advantage over identical random features and strong CAL-only Gaussian KRR on hidden-parameter nonlinear switched worlds.

arms.type: trainable 2→32→12 tanh MLP on raw state/action, 12-dim ridge adaptive coefficients per world; same initial MLP as random
identical initial MLP but never trained; same ridge coefficient adaptation
strong conventional RBF kernel ridge over raw (x,u); gamma, decay, regularization CALIBRATION-ONLY
32-unit GRU on raw 4-channel continuous history with query-conditioned 3-channel 32-unit MLP future-derivative head
evaluator uses hidden world parameters only to generate ground-truth targets
negative context swap for learned feature and RBF predictors

world.generator: reuse S16 world() function byte-identically, with NO S16 analytic basis() or consequence() accessible to learned-feature, random-feature, kernel or GRU predictors. Evaluator knows true nonlinear law.
world.nonlinear_family: xnext=x+dt*(-a*x+b*u+c*tanh(2*x)+d*x*u), unknown to all S17 candidate models
world.unseen_function_split: xnext uses tanh(3*x) after switch, unknown to candidates; OOD parameter ranges as S16
world.physics_bias_disclosure: Estimator model uses the known Euler residual (xnext-x)/dt and supervised counterfactual target, so it has a discrete-time numerical dynamics prior, but no correct nonlinear feature formula.

calibration.tie_breaker: argmin mean calibration MSE then smaller gamma then larger decay then larger ridge; never use test splits to select

causal_post_switch_ablation.type: Remove precisely all 12 POST-SWITCH sensor/action/consequence transitions by replacing history indices 20:32 with a repeat of indices 0:12 from the same original world; leave query, true target, first 20 observations intact.
causal_post_switch_ablation.purpose: Test whether causal recent feedback about the changed physical system is needed for predictions. The counterfactual stream is intentionally not a physically continuous trajectory; it is a negative perturbation only, NEVER an evaluation world for positive learning claims.
causal_post_switch_ablation.block_causal_contamination: No target or hidden physical coefficients supplied; ablated history constructed exclusively from observed original past state/action streams.

classifications.report_gru: Independent trained GRU comparator (same newly frozen worlds) always reported.
classifications.no_claim: Fresh data and stricter causal context-ablation negative control address G7-S17's failure to meet unrelated-world-swap threshold on seed307. Original S17 result remains invalid, untouched; S18 does not retroactively qualify it and is not independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
